metadata.description: A crew of Claude Code agents, commands, and hooks modeled on the Bobiverse replicants.

plugins.name: bobiverse
plugins.description: Twenty Bobs, twelve commands, nine hooks. Bob orchestrates; Bill designs; Garfield builds; Homer breaks; Mario audits; Riker ships; Marvin objects; Howard explains. Busters, SUDDAR, and the Prime Directive make the safety rules real.

plugins.name: bobnet-display
plugins.description: BOBNET · Moot Hall — a live relay display that opens when two or more Bobs are running, tracks each from replication to report, and gives Thoth his own sealed card. Optional companion to bobiverse.

plugins.name: bobnet-shield
plugins.description: Redacts PII/PHI from tool results before the model reads them — SSNs, card numbers, NPI, Medicare IDs, DEA numbers, record/member IDs and identifying combinations. Fails closed. Companion to bobiverse.
